label: first token is c or 3 (plus weak diffuse mid-input firing)
explanation: Fires only during the original-input phase, never at <DEL> or during copy. Core: at t=0 when the input is c or 3 it fires every time (dev precision 1.0) with a fixed magnitude (about 0.23 of max for c, 0.33 for 3). That covers about 53% of activations and 62% of mass. The rest is diffuse firing at original positions t=4-6, almost never t=1-2. There, inputs 3 and c are again over-represented and give the largest activations (top examples near max are 3 at t=5), but many other tokens fire weakly too, and c/3 at later positions often stay silent. Adding c/3 at t in {4,5} raises mass recall to 0.81 but drops precision to 0.54 (F1 0.62). Does not fire for other first tokens at t=0.
